title: Wom X EFN Trails
description: Makes WOM weapons have efn trails
body:
With this Resourcepack you can have weapons from **weapons of miracles [2.0]** mod have swing trails
from Epicfight:Nightfall
And you need **EpicFight:Nightfall** for this to work Obviously

If you use BD&Hill resourcepack put this one at higher priority overriding BD&Hill
